notes:
Inbound SMB fintech. Building a transaction insights + support assistant product for neobanks and SMB merchants. Primary goal: replace slow keyword search for transactions with embeddings-backed search and add an in-app chat assistant for complex billing questions. Starting hosted API (self-serve) but repeatedly asks about VPC/dedicated options for future. 

Security: early and specific — "SOC2 Type II or equivalent" asked multiple times; SSO (SAML) required for internal demo environments; wants per-request audit logs and configurable retention (30/90/365d options). "We can't sign a contract without SOC2 in hand" — paraphrase from Head of Ops. 

Performance & cost: target p95 latency < 300ms for chat short-turn UI, bulk ingestion throughput ~50-100 reqs/s for nightly embedding pipeline. Very cost sensitive — asked for guidance on batching, KV caching, quantization recommendations. Interested in Optimize suggestions and cost vs quality tradeoffs. 

Model prefs: leaning open models (Llama2/Mistral-like) with quantized variants to reduce cost. Wants fallback policy to a cheaper model on budget thresholds. 

Trials & usage: used free credits for two PoC projects; ingestion test hit rate limiting after 3k calls in one day. Asked for short-term trial credit extension to complete nightly ingest. 

Stakeholders: CTO (product/infra), Head of Ops (security/compliance), Lead ML Engineer (POC owner).
